The uploaded Sep 29 tree read noise_lines 16 -> 31 (context-core 18 -> 34): the Sep 29 `did/was/were/had` currency cue made unanswerable past-tense asks ('Where did I go to primary school?') past-tense, and factAffinity's +0.2 past bonus lifted facts with ZERO lexical/kind support over MIN_AFFINITY=0.18 — tense was ADMITTING facts. ORIGINAL NOTE: Baseline of the PIC floor — pic/core retrieveKnowledge — over retrieval-core.v1, all understanding flags ON.

⚠️ THIS IS NOT THE PATH PRODUCTION READS, AND THE NOTE SAID OTHERWISE FOR TOO LONG. routes/chat.js:587 hands retrieveKnowledge to Brain.assembleContext as a FLOOR and ships the Context Engine's selection, with AQUA_CONTEXT_V2=on in the environment template. This suite grades the floor; context-core.v1 grades what the user actually sees. Both are kept, because 'the floor improved' and 'the answer improved' are different claims and folding them into one number is how the gap stayed invisible.

AFTER E7 lane 5 — the polarity lane, the first lane that proposes candidates on a CLAIM ATTRIBUTE rather than on surface words or graph adjacency:
  recall_negation 0.3000 -> 0.8000; mrr, ndcg@8, recall@8, top1_correct and top1_kind all moved up with it, because the negated answer was previously never reaching the pool.
  unknown_honesty (0.71875) and noise_lines (16) UNCHANGED — the load-bearing part. A non-lexical lane is the shape that historically buys recall with noise; this one cannot, because it only runs when the QUESTION carries a negation cue and zero of the 32 silence-expecting queries do.

TWO NEGATION CASES REMAIN MISSED ON PURPOSE (q128, q135). Both need 'We chose Postgres over Mongo', where the negation attaches to the OBJECT, not the statement. Surface polarity cannot see that; it needs E6 typed claims. Adding 'over' as a cue would move this number and be wrong.

recall_category (0.46875) is the worst metric on BOTH lanes and is not fixable this way — its failures are semantic gaps ('educational background' -> 'I studied physics') that a hand-built lexicon would only fit to this dataset.

A further change must beat these WITHOUT moving unknown_honesty or noise_lines down. Regenerate with: npm run eval:gate -- retrieval-core --update
